raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationship, incorrectly identifying Marie Zéphyrine’s mother (Maria Josepha of Saxony) as her paternal grandmother. They failed to trace the paternal line correctly (father: Louis, Dauphin of France; paternal grandparents: Louis XV and Marie Leszczyńska) and prematurely concluded the task without proper verification.
